Chapter 606: Chapter 34 Return (Shuttle ends, please subscribe)

“`

The Rule of Time, is a pillar of the world’s constitution, and the highest level among all pillar rules.

To comprehend life rules, Space Rules, and other pillar rules, one only needs to reach the Sixth or Seventh Rank.

But the Rule of Time? Unless one becomes a Multi-Spatial Life at Ninth Rank, one can’t even feel the oscillations of the Rule of Time, let alone comprehend it.

Even Lin Yuan, who possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding, did not choose to forcibly comprehend the Rule of Time at Eighth Layer, as the efficiency would be too low, and thus not worthwhile.

“Two thousand one hundred seventy-three kinds of Time Rule Models, by now I have thoroughly comprehended eight hundred fifty-one…”

...

Lin Yuan thought to himself, knowing well that a normal Ninth Rank powerhouse would not spend too much effort comprehending the Rule of Time, often not even entering the threshold within the Nine Myriad Heavy Realm.

Tenth Rank powerhouses have a deeper comprehension of the Rule of Time, but are only between comprehending two hundred to five hundred Time Rule Models.

As for eight hundred fifty-one Time Rule Models? That’s something only an extremely powerful and special Tenth Rank powerhouse could achieve, or perhaps even the domain of an Eleventh Rank powerhouse.

To fully comprehend the Rule of Time… only an Eleventh Rank Peak powerhouse, preparing to try to strike at the Supreme Being’s level, could reach that level.

One of the prerequisites for striking at the Supreme Being realm is to thoroughly comprehend the Rule of Time, then merge it with Space Rules, take control of space-time, and make the Ultimate Leap.

During this process, spreading one’s own Evolution Path, the more beings that practice it, the greater the momentum becomes for the Ultimate Leap.

“Regrettably, there are too few True God Forms and Main Godly Cores that contain the attribute of time. Only the Godly Cores of the God of Divination and the Prime God of Light possess the time attribute, and there is only one True Divine Nature that has it…”

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly, if there were more Divine Lattices containing the time attribute, he was confident in comprehending a thousand Time Models.

Being able to comprehend a thousand Time Rule Models at the Ninth Rank, although not unprecedented like opening up more than two billion three hundred million Spatial Layers, would certainly be considered earth-shatteringly against heaven’s will.

Generally, only those unique and special beings with a talent for time could hope to achieve this.

“Time slow down…”

With a slight intention from Lin Yuan, the flow of time at his body’s surface began to slow, rapidly decelerating, with a day passing in the outside world equating to only an hour for Lin Yuan, a time flow speed of twelve to one.

This is also the maximum limit of time flow speed Lin Yuan can currently manipulate, mainly because his Life Level is too profound, and the price of slowing down his own time flow is too terrifying.

If it were an ordinary Ninth Rank life, Lin Yuan could easily make their own time flow speed reach one to a thousand compared to the outside world.

In the River of Time, the energy needed to slow down a whale far exceeds the energy needed to slow down a small fish.

“After slowing down time, even the perception of the Great Dao rules becomes blurred…” Lin Yuan is currently experiencing a time flow speed of only one to twelve compared to the outside world.

Even so, the clarity of his perception of the Great Dao rules has plummeted.

One can infer that in an environment where the time flow speed reaches several thousand to tens of thousands to one, it would be nearly impossible to comprehend the Great Dao rules of the outside world.

“No wonder those Ninth Rank and Tenth Rank powerhouses are reluctant to use time treasures such as the Time Chamber for cultivation…” Lin Yuan mused thoughtfully.

The Supreme Beings of the Main World have the power to slow down the time flow speed of a certain area and even can concoct treasures such as Secret Treasures.

However, in such an environment where the time flow speed is slowed down, it doesn’t really help one’s own cultivation, and the time spent is actual lifespan.

“Just because the time flow speed of a certain area is different, it leads to a fuzziness in the perception of the Great Dao Rules because the Great Dao Rules themselves will naturally fluctuate with the main time flow speed.”

“But by utilizing the Door to the Myriad Realms to traverse through dimensions, this dimensional realm where I’m situated has such a time flow speed, and even if it differs from the Main World’s time flow speed, it doesn’t affect the comprehension of the Great Dao Rules…”

Lin Yuan realized another benefit of crossing dimensions through the Door to the Myriad Realms.

…

Six hundred years passed, and apart from the Rule of Time, Lin Yuan also completely comprehended the essences of other rules, such as the life rule.

This time, with the help of the Divine Lattices of gods and True God Forms, it was undoubtedly a tremendous help to Lin Yuan, at least saving a lot of time.

Without these True God Forms, even if Lin Yuan could still reach his current height, the time required would have been much longer.

Not utilizing the ‘key-like’ effects of Divine Lattices, Lin Yuan’s efficiency would definitely be much lower.

…

Time passed.

Two years went by.

The Longshan Fang Couple gradually grew old and died, reaching the limit of lifespan in this world. Unless one ignited the divine fire and changed the essence of life, natural death was inevitable.

This time, Lin Yuan did not use the power of the world within him to delay his parents’ death, because there was no point; a year later upon his return, the Longshan Fang Couple would still be dead.

Whether they lived a year longer or less made no significant difference.

And as the Longshan Fang Couple faced death, they had no fear, having birthed a son who opened a new epoch, a matter of immense honor.

Human world.

Ruins of Longshan City.

In front of the graveyard of the Longshan Family.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared, this time to the human world, it was not his two Primordial Spirits, but his True Body Itself.

Lin Yuan stood in front of his parents’ tombstones, his expression calm, showing neither joy nor sorrow, just standing there silently.

Around the graveyard, important members of the Longshan Family intermittently came and went; after all, the Longshan Fang Couple were the parents of Longshan Yuan, holding an unshakable status within the Longshan Family. Their death was significant enough that even the Martial Tao True Gods of the Martial Realm would descend their godly force incarnations to pay a visit.
